proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Successive reductions put u into a quasi-affine reduced U carrying a dense invariant open W on which the restrictions of s and t are finite locally free. Two applications of the almost-invariant-function lemma produce invariant affine opens, one inside W containing the finitely many generic points above the orbit and one inside the reduced closed complement Z containing u. The norm, invariant by the determinant trick, of the pullback of the second function gives an invariant function g on W, and the union V of the g-open part of the first affine open with the second piece is shown open by constructibility plus an explicit generalization chase, invariant by construction, and affine by the get-affine criterion, finishing the proof. (source lines 3034-3167)
